lines.en: One beat of my tail carries me ten meters.

lines.zh: 整群一起走，水都变了向。
lines.en: The whole school moves, and the water turns with us.
I cruise down along the thermocline.
There is a school ahead, so I surge forward.

lines.zh: 深海蓝得发黑，我照样游。
lines.en: The deep sea is nearly black, and I swim on.

lines.zh: 我的尾柄一抖，像上了发条。
lines.en: My tail base twitches like a wound spring.

lines.zh: 转弯时我侧身划出一道弧。
lines.en: Turning, I roll onto my side and carve an arc.

lines.zh: 深水压过来，我一点不怕。
lines.en: Deep water presses in, and I am not afraid.
I swing around a ridge on the seabed.
My schoolmates lead, and I stay right behind.
With warm water, I swim even faster.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进冷水，又浮上来。
lines.en: I dive into cold water, then rise again.
There is a shadow behind me, so I speed up.

lines.zh: 这片海太开阔，我一路直冲。
lines.en: This sea is so open that I charge straight on.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从浪底下钻过去。
lines.en: I drop low and slip under the swell.

lines.zh: 鳃一张，水就从两边过去了。
lines.en: My gills open and the water slides past.

lines.zh: 前面那道暗流，我借它走。
lines.en: That current ahead is one I ride.

lines.zh: 我一口气窜出水面又落回。
lines.en: I leap clear and drop back in a breath.

lines.zh: 后面那条追不上我，太慢了。
lines.en: The one behind cannot keep up; too slow.

lines.zh: 我斜着往下，钻进冷水层。
lines.en: I angle down into the cold layer.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，鳃一直张着。
lines.en: I hang in the water with my gills wide open.

lines.zh: 阳光从上面漏下来几条。
lines.en: Sunlight leaks down in a few thin shafts.
I beat my tail slowly to hold my place.

lines.zh: 有只小鱿鱼在石头边躲着。
lines.en: A small squid hides beside a rock.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来晒一面。
lines.en: I turn my flank up to catch the light.

lines.zh: 暖流裹着我，我几乎不摆尾。
lines.en: A warm current wraps me, and I barely beat my tail.

lines.zh: 我听见远处鲸叫一样的低音。
lines.en: I hear a low call far off, like a whale.
A schoolmate circles me once.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴冲水，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: Mouth open, I ram water through my gills.
The blue of the deep wraps around me.
I watch the bright patches far above.
A warm current slides along my back.
I let out a loud sneeze.

lines.zh: 海底沙上有一道旧划痕。
lines.en: There is an old scar in the seabed sand.
You look clumsy in all that gear underwater.
You are smaller than me, and slower.

lines.zh: 我从你左边掠到右边，很快。
lines.en: I sweep from your left to your right, quickly.
Your bubbles rise far too fast.
Whose fish is that in your hand?
I stare at your legs.
You are not a shark, so I am not afraid.
You have come down to my depth.
Your lamp hurts my eyes.
One arm's length away, that is close enough.
Ouch! Who bit my tail base?
I only have ten health, so do not try it.
That blow sent me swimming crooked.
Blood draws sharks, so I must go.
I whip my tail to shake off the pain.
Do not bite from behind, that is low.
One of my scales has peeled up.
I want to charge, but my body will not.
This wound is enough to remember you by.

lines.zh: 我往深处退，缓过这阵疼。
lines.en: I withdraw deeper to let the pain pass.
That small fish in your hand, give it here.
The smell of blood spreads through the water.
I circle away and come back.
This smell is worth stopping for.
Drop it and I will catch it.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴等你再丢一条。
lines.en: My mouth is open, waiting for another one.
An empty hook? I can tell.
Set it a little deeper.
I got there before my schoolmates.
For this bite, I owe you a favor.

lines.zh: 整群挤过来，撞你个正着。
lines.en: The whole school crowds in and hits you square on.

lines.zh: 我擦过你的肩，像块石头。
lines.en: I graze your shoulder like a passing stone.
Do not stand in the middle of the fish road.
The squid escaped, and I hit you instead.
My snout knocks against your armor.
A schoolmate swerves, and I crash into it.
The water squeezes, and we pile up together.
Back off, my school does not brake.
My tail fin fans a faceful of water at you.
I bash a path open and keep swimming.
Nobody yields when food is on the line.
Just a bump, do not hold a grudge.
The silver lines on her body shine brightly.

lines.zh: 我们并排冲同一道暖流。
lines.en: We ride the same warm current side by side.
I circle her, my tail fin trembling.

lines.zh: 整群都在转圈，我们也是。
lines.en: The whole school is circling, and so are we.
She heads deeper, and I follow.
Our shadows overlap into one long shape.
She churns the water into a string of bubbles.
This season the sea will be busy.
I swim pressed against her flank.

lines.zh: 两道银影一齐冲出水面。
lines.en: Two silver shapes break the surface at once.
This chunk of fish sinks, and it is mine.
I grab it and swallow without chewing.
I take everything you drop.

lines.zh: 钩上的饵，我当礼物拿了。
lines.en: The bait on that hook, I take as a gift.
Iron scrap? I spat that out.

lines.zh: 我在水里捡到一枚亮片。
lines.en: I found a shiny scale in the water.

lines.zh: 食物不能沉到沙里浪费。
lines.en: Food must not sink into the sand and waste.
I swallowed it whole and nearly choked.
With my mouth full, I swim slowly.
Whoever dropped it, thank you.

lines.zh: 那群小鱼在慌，我看见了。
lines.en: That little school is panicking, and I see it.

lines.zh: 一只鱿鱼正往石缝里钻。
lines.en: A squid is squeezing into a rock crevice.
A twitch in the sand, and I lock on.
They bunch into one ball, which suits me.
There is blood in the water, not far.
I have my eye on the fat one.
My schoolmates charge, and I cannot fall behind.
That silver mass is moving, and it is prey.
The squid inks the water, and I still chase.
The target will not get far; I am fast.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，对准它的尾巴。
lines.en: I lower my body and aim at its tail.
It changes direction, and I turn with it.
I count its tailbeats, waiting for an opening.
The school rings it round, and the circle closes.
It hugs the rock, and I hug it closer.
The ink is clearing, so I wait a moment.
I tense my tail base, storing the power.

lines.zh: 它尾巴一偏，我立刻压上去。
lines.en: Its tail flicks aside, and I press in at once.
A flash of spray means it has turned.
Half a meter more and I can reach it.
One bite punches through its back.

lines.zh: 五点的劲儿，一下够它受。
lines.en: Five points of force, and once is enough.
I ram it, and it turns belly up.
My teeth snap shut, and the water shakes.
It thrashes twice, and I do not let go.
I drive into it from the side.
That ram hurt my snout too.
A squid tentacle still hangs from my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬住一甩，它飞进浑水里。
lines.en: I bite and whip my head; it flies into the murk.
Blood blooms in the water like a flower.

lines.zh: 深海暗处，我们四条一起出来。
lines.en: In the dark deep, the four of us emerge together.
A warm current carried me to this sea.
The moment I appear, I start swimming.

lines.zh: 海面离得很远，这里正合适。
lines.en: The surface is far above, and this suits me.

lines.zh: 同伴有三条，跟在我后面。
lines.en: Three schoolmates trail behind me.
The deep temperate sea is familiar ground.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾，认了这片水。
lines.en: I flick my tail and claim this water.
At this depth, only a trace of sunlight remains.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，先灌一口深海水。
lines.en: I open my mouth and take a draught of deep seawater.
We form a line and dive downward.
The sea is burning, and I bolt upward.

lines.zh: 我摔在甲板上，拍得生疼。
lines.en: I hit the deck and slap down hard.

lines.zh: 空气里，我的鳃一片片粘住。
lines.en: In air, my gills stick together plate by plate.
The blast flips me over twice.
An arrow buries itself in my flank.
A flash of light burrows into my bones.

lines.zh: 追了一整天，什么也没吃到。
lines.en: I hunted all day and caught nothing.

lines.zh: 雷电劈开海面，我全身僵住。
lines.en: Lightning splits the surface, and I lock up.

lines.zh: 没有水压，我的骨头在响。
lines.en: Without water pressure, my bones creak.
